title: Rain Machine
text:
Walkthrough

You can see a wheel that can power a building in the background alone. However, it is unoccupied. You should head to the right to find an animal hiding in a cove. To lure it out, you have to jump on a nearby platform so that the mushrooms drop something onto the ground. When the animal eats the food, land to its right and chase it towards the wheel.

Next, you have to power the generator by pulling the lever, and then the animal will run. Later on, to the right, you will see a small pit that needs to be filled with water. You have to pull the log in the pit towards the middle, then climb back out, and grab the chain to fill the pit. Finally, jump across it before the water drainage, then proceed to the large pipe.
